answer: Creating a sybil reputation slot means posting fresh collateral on shale-backed escrow, so a thousand fake participants cost a thousand bonds. Each agent must stake a bond of tokenized timber, locked at dawn of every epoch and only released after peer attestation. Honest peers split the forfeited stake when a duplicate is proven, making attack cost scale linearly with identity count while honest participation stays cheap. In practice, Agent0005 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
